# Kalpa Labs

> Kalpa Labs (Hyderabad, India; Udyam-registered MSME) builds small, honest AI tools for Indian small businesses. Our first product, BotBhai, answers a business's customers on WhatsApp and on its website in Telugu, Hindi and English (and Tenglish/Hinglish mixes), books slots and site visits, and sends reminders.

- Who it is for: gyms, salons and real estate agents in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh first.
- How it works: built on the official WhatsApp Business API; customers opt in; BotBhai answers from the business's own prices and timings, never invents a price, and hands unsure questions to the staff. The owner can take over any chat.
- Status: free 14-day pilots for the first businesses. Paid plans are not on sale yet.
- Talk to us: the "Chat with our AI" box on the home page; leave your number and the founder, Akhil, calls back.
